description:
Fetch a URL and grade its HTTP security headers (HSTS, Content-Security-Policy, X-Content-Type-Options, X-Frame-Options, Referrer-Policy, Permissions-Policy, COOP). Returns a 0–100 score, an A–F grade, and per-header notes.

Args:
  - url (string): URL or host to check (scheme defaults to https://).
  - response_format ('markdown' | 'json'): output format (default 'markdown').

Returns: { url, final_url, status, grade, score, checks[{header, present, value, note}], missing[] }.

Example: "Grade the security headers on https://news.ycombinator.com" -> http_security_headers(url="https://news.ycombinator.com").
Errors: returns an error if the URL is invalid or the host is unreachable.

response_format.description: Output format: 'markdown' for a human-readable summary (default) or 'json' for the full structured payload.

url.description: URL or host to check, e.g. 'https://example.com'.

name: http_security_headers
title: HTTP Security Headers
